hook_text: Sales went from 98 to 102. This graph makes it look like they tripled.
clip_script: Suppose a shop's monthly sales were 98, 100 and 102. If the axis starts at 96, the last bar looks three times as tall as the first, suggesting huge growth — but sales rose by only about four percent.
visual_style: Three bars with an axis starting at 96 tower dramatically; the axis slides down to 0 and the bars become almost equal.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson to read every graph like a detective.
